1) Margin impact: finance needs a clear P&L for the three-month pilot run — can you include expected gross margin at list vs. at 40% discount (and call out any incremental infra costs tied to burst QPS)?

Subject: Anchorly exception memo for VP sign-off — request & recommended guardrails

Markus / Marissa — per notes below, I prepared the short approval packet for exec sign-off. Please review and approve (or mark edits) so I can return to Anchorly with a single answer.

Summary (one line): Approve a structured one-off concession to Anchorly Health for a Q4 Accelerator pilot with a 30% up-front discount + conditional convert-or-credit ladder; 45-day Net terms; credit recoup on conversion.

Recommended guardrails (what we will offer):
- Pricing: 30% discount off Accelerator list for months 1–3 (applies immediately). If Anchorly converts to Redwood Dedicated within 120 days of pilot completion, we will apply an additional credit equal to the remaining 10% (total 40% concession) to the first month invoice of Dedicated.
- Usage/Overage: Overage tokens billed at list price; monthly reconciliation required. Any underreported usage will be invoiced with 10% admin surcharge.
- Terms: 45-day Net; standard Redwood T&Cs; payment holdback: Redwood reserves the right to withhold final conversion credit until usage reconciliation and signature on conversion SOW.
- Cap: Maximum concession exposure capped at $60k (total credit cap for the three-month pilot).

Commercial rationale: Strategic reference in cardiology vertical; high conversion probability; ability to convert to Dedicated will generate predictable ARR. The cap preserves margin.

Attachments to the memo: Anchorly_SOW_redline_20260906.pdf; anchorly-usage-forecast-q4.csv; internal-margin-estimate-v1.xlsx (note: internal file is attached in mailbox but redacted in external copy).

Requested action: Markus — sign off (OK to approve with guardrails) or propose edits. Marissa — please confirm the $60k credit cap and margin math by EOD so we can respond to Anchorly before their finance meeting on Monday.

If approved, I'll send a short one-page approval memo for VP/CFO signatures and then route to Anchorly with the convert-or-credit language.

Thanks — Priya
